note: Round 3 sample themes for the OR-11 two-scorer check. Articles are real items from the live RSS feeds on 2026-10-04 (headline, source, link, RSS snippet cut at 200 characters). Theme text is written by the Researcher. Round 3 uses the competition line: government programmes, NGO services and free public tools count as substitutes when they serve the same buyer at no cost.

themes.title: Earthquake and flood resilience services for Indonesian buildings and small businesses
themes.thesis: Strong quakes hit Sumba and Aceh Jaya, experts warn about shifting megathrust zones, and flash floods hit Solok: sell building-safety inspections, retrofit advice and low-cost disaster-cover enrolment to small property owners and shop owners in high-risk regions.

themes.title: Household energy-saving and rooftop-solar advice for cost-pressed consumers
themes.thesis: UK energy bills are forecast to rise by the most in four years and suppliers are pressing the government, while a US oil region adopts solar: sell home energy audits, tariff switching help and small solar installs to households squeezed by bills.

themes.title: Compliance and fleet tools for ride-hailing motorbike drivers and small transport operators
themes.thesis: The government is moving motorbike taxis (ojol) into the public-transport category, preparing upper and lower fare limits for more modes and a new operator certificate requirement: sell permit tracking, fare-limit checks and driver-group management software to operators and driver communities.
